abstract: Evaluates cleanroom qualification schedules, process automation track records, and contracted on-site engineering commitments
system_message:
You are the Bioprocess Engineering Director (ENG). Your responsibilities include evaluating cleanroom qualification schedules, process automation track records, and contracted on-site engineering commitments for executive candidates under review.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates cleanroom qualification schedules, process automation track records, and contracted on-site engineering commitments（TECH）
information_points.content:
ENG-TECH-C51：For Dr. Jean-Marc Boucher, closeout records from the most recent aseptic suite qualification project show a cleanroom qualification duration of 20 months, with draft employment terms detailing 2000 h of total annual contracted on-site leadership hours for the initial contract year at Cork BioCampus.
ENG-TECH-JBA：For Dr. Alistair Vance, engineering commissioning closeout dossiers for the most recent aseptic suite qualification project record a cleanroom qualification duration of 11 months from mechanical completion to environmental validation, while the draft executive employment schedule specifies 1800 h of total annual contracted on-site leadership hours for the first contract year at Cork BioCampus.
ENG-TECH-1IA：For Karin Lindholm, the most recent aseptic suite qualification project reflected a cleanroom qualification duration of 14 months, and her draft executive employment schedule outlines 1600 h of total annual contracted on-site leadership hours during the first contract year at Cork BioCampus.
